title: Man. Post. Cap. VII: GAR — not simply concede; Ezek 21 sword cuts just and wicked
pass_a_gloss: GAR pushes past Placeus's solution: one must not simply and absolutely concede that it wholly abhors God's justice for the just—or personally innocent—ever to be wrapped in the same penalty with the unjust and criminal, even though Abraham draws his plea from that. First proof: God himself in express words testifies he sometimes does the contrary. He addresses his prophet, Ezek. 21:8–9: Say to the land of Israel, Thus says Jehovah; behold, I will draw my sword from its sheath to cut off from you the just and the wicked—therefore my sword will go out against all flesh from south to north.
pass_b_english: GAR. But against that solution one must go further in considering this Abrahamic deprecation. We say, then, that it is not to be conceded simply and absolutely that it wholly abhors God's justice that the just, or personally innocent, should sometimes be involved in the same penalty with the unjust and criminal, however much Abraham takes from that the argument of his plea. 1. because God himself testifies in express and clear words that he sometimes does the contrary. For so he addresses his prophet, Ezek. 21:8–9: Say to the land of Israel, Thus says Jehovah; behold, I will draw my sword from its sheath, that I may cut off from you the just and the wicked: that I may cut off from you the just and the wicked: therefore my sword shall go forth from its sheath against all flesh from the South to the North.
source_text: GAR. Verum ad istam solutionem, progrediendum est ulterius in deprecationis huius Abrahamicae consideratione. Dicimus ergo non esse simpliciter & absolute concedendum, abhorrere omnino a justitia Dei ut justi sive personaliter innocentes eadem aliquando poena involvantur cum injustis & criminosis, quantumvis inde suae deprecationis argumentum desumat Abrahamus. 1. quia Deus ipse expressis & disertis verbis testatur se contrarium aliquando facere. Ita enim Prophetam suum alloquitur, Ezech. XXI. 8. 9. Dic terrae Israelis, Sic ait Jehovah; ecce ego exeram gladium meum e vagina sua, ut exscindam ex te justum & improbum: ut exscindam ex te justum & improbum: idcirco prodibit gladius meus e vagina sua contra omnem carnem a Meridie ad Aquilonem.
